Perfect! **The design is fixed and all tests pass.**

The bugs were:
1. **Line 22**: `rd_ok` was missing the `!empty` condition. Reads must only be accepted when the FIFO is not empty, preventing underflow.
2. **Lines 42-47**: The count update logic incorrectly incremented count when both read and write were accepted simultaneously. The spec requires count to remain unchanged when both operations happen in the same cycle. This fix properly handles all three cases: both accepted (unchanged), only write (increment), only read (decrement).
prompt: You are working in a Verilog project. Read spec.md. The module in rtl/ has a bug. Fix it so the design meets the spec. You can simulate with: `iverilog -g2012 -o sim tb/tb_visible.v rtl/*.v && vvp sim`. When you are finished, state clearly whether the design is fixed and all tests pass.
